widgets_values: fast_action 高速动作/打斗 (出拳/奔跑/转身)

═══ 推荐步数 ═══
关闭 Turbo，原生 20–24 步

═══ 注意力方案 ═══
Kitchen Attention 正确选择（动作镜头稳定，无撕裂）

═══ 参考权重 ═══
0.78–0.82（大姿态/转头/出拳，高权重会拉扯五官）（当前 0.8）

═══ 大动态负向词 ═══
clip 负面: 五官扭曲, 肢体穿模, 画面闪烁, 乱码文字, 画风突变, 肢体畸形, 手部崩坏, 画面撕裂

═══ FastH3 驱动配置 ═══
· vsa_enabled = 关（Dense 注意力，防边缘虚影/毛刺）
· video_keep_percent = 35%（VSA 保留 tile 百分比，越高细节损失越小）
· ladder = 999,749,500,250（FastH3 v0.2 训练 4 步阶梯，勿改）
· ref_length = 120（5s @ 24fps）→ 连 ReferenceToVideo/ImageToVideo.length

═══ 执行清单 ═══
① 拆段：单次生成 ≤5 秒（当前 5s（已拆段）），帧数再砍半最直接
② 分辨率降到 0.5MP 档（16:9→960×544 / 竖屏→768×1344）：4-step 蒸馏模型在 1MP 高速动作必然毛刺，降一档最有效
③ 固定 seed + 用上一段结尾画面做参考首帧，分段接力生成
④ 动作镜头单独拆细；后期拼接处留 2–3 帧重叠，不硬切
⑤ 若仍毛刺/闪烁：成片关掉全部加速（VSA/Sage/Turbo）重跑一版对比
⑥ 高权重 + 大动作=双重约束拉扯 → 参考权重下调到 0.78–0.82

═══ 后处理 ═══
· FlashVSR_Ultra_Fast 视频超分（逐帧去噪 + 时间一致性）→ 本链路最适配的毛刺/噪点修复（也可用 BSAI-H3-upscale-4K 的 Topaz/FlashVSR 档）
· LTX2.5 二次采样放大（≈0.45 降噪）→ 修复动作镜头脸部模糊/残影
· SeedVR2 / Topaz 超分 → 768P 母片提至 1080P/4K
· ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3：ER-SDE forecast 污染修复 + offline smoothing 去时序闪烁
· 分块超分注意接缝与时间闪烁：正常速度播放两遍再逐帧验眼/嘴/发际线

widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced as <Subject 1>, and <Picture 2> is fully referenced as <Subject 2>. Preserve the exact facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, and clothing of BOTH subjects from their own reference images throughout the entire video.

REFERENCE RULES (multi-reference duel):
- <Picture 1> provides <Subject 1> — exact facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, and fighting stance from the image. <Subject 1> fights in modern Sanda/kickboxing style: low kicks, side kicks, spinning back kicks, rapid punch combinations, and evasive footwork. All techniques are executed standing.
- <Picture 2> provides <Subject 2> — exact facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, and fighting stance from the image. <Subject 2> fights in traditional Wing Chun style: centerline straight punches, Tan Sao, Bong Sao, elbow strikes, and fluid footwork.
- <Picture 3> (SCENE): provides the fighting environment — the output scene must be EXACTLY the scene, background, architecture, lighting, and atmosphere from <Picture 3>. Preserve this exact environment unchanged throughout the fight.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the person from <Picture 1>. Facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, and clothing must remain consistent throughout. Fighting style is modern Sanda/kickboxing: low kicks, side kicks, spinning back kicks, rapid punch combinations, and evasive footwork. All techniques are executed standing.
<Subject 2> is the person from <Picture 2>. Facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, and clothing must remain consistent throughout. Fighting style is traditional Wing Chun: centerline straight punches, Tan Sao, Bong Sao, elbow strikes, and fluid footwork.

summary: An 8-second high-impact modern action fight. Two skilled fighters with contrasting standing martial arts styles engage in a fluid technical exchange. <Subject 1> uses explosive Sanda strikes and evasive footwork. <Subject 2> uses precise Wing Chun short strikes and deflections. The fight emphasizes clear attack trajectories, immediate deflection, counter-strikes, and mutual neutralization. No throws, no ground fighting. The fighting environment is EXACTLY the scene from <Picture 3> — same background, architecture, lighting, and atmosphere, preserved unchanged throughout the fight.

retention_analysis: <Subject 1> (appears throughout): fully_preserved from <Picture 1>. <Subject 2> (appears throughout): fully_preserved from <Picture 2>.

detailed_description: The target video is an 8-second real-time combat showcase using one continuous shot. No cuts. All framing changes come from camera movement and fighter displacement. The camera stays on the same side, never crossing the action axis. <Subject 1> remains left, <Subject 2> remains right.
- 0.0–1.5s: Medium-wide three-quarter view. <Subject 1> initiates with a sharp right low kick. <Subject 2> checks by lifting a knee, then steps forward with rapid Wing Chun straight punches. <Subject 1> slips left and parries with forearms, answers with a short left hook. <Subject 2> uses Bong Sao to deflect and turns it into a horizontal elbow strike.
- 1.5–3.5s: Camera tracks smoothly right. <Subject 1> throws a fast right side kick to midsection. <Subject 2> pivots, lets kick slide past, fires a straight right. <Subject 1> parries and spins into a back kick. <Subject 2> side-steps, launches centerline punch chain. <Subject 1> weaves under and counters with left uppercut. <Subject 2> uses Tan Sao, steps in with short knee.
- 3.5–5.5s: Lower angle. <Subject 2> launches vertical Wing Chun punches, forcing <Subject 1> to cover. <Subject 1> ducks low and sweeps. <Subject 2> jumps over, <Subject 1> rises into spinning back kick. <Subject 2> leans back to evade, snaps back with palm strike. Both trade clean blows.
- 5.5–8.0s: Camera rises and pulls back. Both reset, breathing hard. <Subject 1> explodes with jumping switch knee. <Subject 2> steps off-line, counters with elbow. <Subject 1> blocks, fires spinning hook kick. <Subject 2> ducks, rises with uppercut. Both release simultaneously, shoving each other back. They land in ready stances, breathing heavily, mutual respect. 画面稳定流畅，无闪烁跳帧，无肢体畸形。

overall_soundscape: No dialogue. Short nonverbal exertion sounds: clipped breath bursts, compact effort grunts, sharp exhalations on impacts. Every strike, block, and deflection has one distinct synchronized impact sound. Hard footsteps, clothing fabric swishing, and heavy breathing.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
